title: MD5 use via md5.convert (dart) — review required
description: The dart call md5.convert computes MD5, which is broken for security purposes (collisions are practical). It is unacceptable for passwords, signatures, or integrity of untrusted data, but still fine for non-security checksums. This lexical rule cannot tell the use case — treat every hit as review-required.
remediation: Use sha256.convert for any security purpose. Keep MD5 only for non-security checksums with a comment saying so.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches any md5.convert call regardless of purpose. Bare md5() calls belong to the generic rule; other weak algorithms are separate rules.
